subject: general
question: In 5 years, the simple interest on an amount of Rs. X is 2th over5 of the principal. The rate of interest per annum is:
solution:
Given:

Time = 5 years

Simple interest = (2/5) of principal

Formula used:

Simple interest = (Principal × Time × Rate)/100

Calculation:

Let the Principal be 5

Rate% = r%

According to question

Simple interest = 2/5 of principal

⇒ S.I. = 2/5 × 5 = 2

∴ S.I. = 2

⇒ 2 = (5 × r × 5)/100

⇒ Rate = (2 × 100)/ (25)

Rate% = 8

**∴ The required rate is 8%.**
